info.title: Paysafe Applications API
info.description: White-labelled merchant onboarding. Submit applications, track underwriting decisions and manage sub-merchant accounts programmatically, individually or in bulk.

tags.name: Sub-merchants
tags.description: Manage sub-merchant accounts created from approved applications.

tags.name: Termination inquiry
tags.description: Screen sub-merchants against scheme termination databases.

post.description: Creates a new application. Supply a unique `merchantRefNum` so the request can be safely retried.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of applications, most recent first.
Retrieves a single application by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing application.

post.description: Submits a completed application for underwriting review.
Withdraws an application that has not yet been decisioned.
